name: mmsave-tiles-blobs-sd
description: the editor re-renders war3mapMap.blp on every save (the input's is flat.w3x's picture, a different map; the editor's save of this map is the picture of its ground, which Studio's rebuild matches): the ground in squares of 4 x 4 corners (tiles with two to four textures at the squares' edges), 16-pixel squares within 8 per channel (the largest was 3). SD. Not the random-corner map (minimap-tiles-rand.w3x): there the editor's JPEG itself moves the colours (its saved picture is redder than its own export by 6 to 9 on the green textures, blue 8 lower on Lrok: its encoder's chroma), squares differ by up to 15

name: mmsave-tiles-blobs-hd
description: the same in HD (the ground colours are the _Diffuse textures')

name: mmsave-dots-sd
description: 48 isolated doodads of three kinds (a rock 4x4, an elven house 6x6, a goblin shipyard ruin 8x8 pathing), SD, 4 pixels a tile: the dots' colours and places agree within 12 per channel in 16-pixel squares. A dot is the tiles [u - a, u + a] touches, a = (cells - 2) / 8 (dotReach), softened at the tile edges as the editor does (before branch we-minimap-2: discs of 1.4 to 2.8 tiles, 8 in the largest square)

name: mmsave-dots-hd
description: the same in HD (the editor's dot colours: the _Diffuse textures')

name: mmsave-dots-128-sd
description: 128 x 128 tiles, 2 pixels a tile (the scale of real maps): 16 doodads each of eight kinds (4x4, 6x6, 8x8, 12x12, 8x6 and 4x6 pathing, a palisade without one, a vineyard), their centres moved a quarter pixel at a time. At 2 pixels a tile every pixel is a tile corner pixel: a one tile dot has all four pixels at 0.17 and vanishes, a 4x4 doodad is 2 x 2 tiles at a tile edge and one tile at the middle (before branch we-minimap-2 Studio drew discs: 8 per cent of the squares off by more than 12)

name: mmsave-dots-more-sd
description: a tree (its own minimap colour), a 12x12 doodad, 8x6 and 4x6 ones, the palisade (no pathing texture: a grey dot, 183 on all channels) and a vineyard, 4 pixels a tile: the full-rectangle textures are dots of tiles whatever their shape (before branch we-minimap-2 the 8x6 and 4x6 were drawn as their cells and the palisade not at all)
